title: watch: no limit on SSE HTTP header line length — heap exhaustion via read_line
description: watch_once reads HTTP response headers using buf_reader.read_line() with no maximum line length. BufReader::read_line reads until newline regardless of length. A misbehaving kithd could send an arbitrarily long header line causing unbounded heap allocation before the 100-header guard fires. Same issue in jmap_post headers loop. Fix: check line.len() after each read_line and return an error if it exceeds a reasonable bound (e.g. 8 KiB).
